profile.headline: Web Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I have been working with kids since I was fifteen and have been a teacher for my entire adult life. I am looking to carry the skills I have learned from teaching--such as leadership, organization, and flexibility--and intertwine them with the software development skills I have been growing since 2020. 

I am proficient with C#, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL, .Net, Git, Visual Studio, Unity Engine, agile development, and building APIs and MVCs.

Graduating from Eleven Fifty Academy not only strengthened all of these hard skills, but has also refined the soft skills that I had learned through teaching and molded them to fit the tech industry.  I earned multiple certifications through Eleven Fifty Academy's courses.

I currently utilize my love for learning and developer skills at Sweetwater Sound as a Software Engineer.
